requirements.label: Maintenance interval standard
requirements.description: Can state the standing interval and where it is published.
requirements.evidence: Cited the interval correctly without prompting.
requirements.risk_if_untransferred: Windows scheduled against the wrong standard.

requirements.label: Overriding the standing interval
requirements.description: Can decide, unsupervised, when trend conditions make the interval unsafe.
requirements.evidence: Reasoned it out once, with the expert present.
requirements.risk_if_untransferred: Maintenance follows the calendar into the high-demand season.

requirements.label: Regional operator escalation
requirements.description: Known to the operator well enough to negotiate a window by phone.
requirements.evidence: Every contact in the material went through the expert.
requirements.risk_if_untransferred: Windows that need negotiation simply do not happen.
